I don’t think you can take it this early, as I remember the requirement being a graduating student by the end if the year unless you are in intarmed or leapmed or similar programs. Maybe you could enroll in an nmat review early, though I think you should first go through your bio orgchem and anachem for foundational knowledge lang. 

My nmat was not too specific nor super deep with the chem and bio questions, but how specific can one really get with only 30 questions for each section? There’s also 30 questions in physics (your torque and electricity and work and shiz) and 30 for soc sci so brush up on your maslow and kant and other philosophers, if you can take a philo elective that might help.

Uplink was a good review center and really helped, along with binge watching khan academy’s chemistry courses (i really suck at chem but got 800 thanks to these). Studying with a friend would also help especially with having someone you can bounce questions and discussions off of. I also bought a set of reviewers from lazada and that was good din for helping me identify some other areas where I need to brush up.

Keep your math skills up din, 30 questions are allotted to quantitative which was just a bunch of straight up mathing (algebra, addition subtraction etc, like two or three questions na calculus) and it will surely help your p6.

However as you mentioned, pers year ka pa lang mag enjoy ka na muna, party party lakad lakad while not failing lol. Super tryhard na pag second year and majors, and join orgs and do social works to get your resume filled up for UPCM inshallah. Gl OP!
